New controllers are conditional on enrolled state; provision-false people remain absent until their actual action.

Livelihood/home support reads actual worker sources/body/rights/stock. The shared support-loss branch refunds only refund policy and forfeits the new disclosed paid effort.

Completed grip practice synchronizes after its actual completed count; consequence reconciliation runs after jobs before events; roster/conduct/collector joins run before final validation and remain idempotent for repeated shared joins. Stock, escrow, actual purse payment, one choice, held tool returns and native fitting custody remain with declared existing owners.

All six lane families, one source and ten distinct native item specifications are aggregated; the native item registration is source-linked through expedition_items. Root router preserves exact lane control payloads, including offers causes, fit cancellation jobId and objective attemptId; Notebook points retained player jobs to Here. Explicit player records and local observation controls avoid exposing private NPC work records as knowledge.

The retained future-trade consequence is joined into both common simulation previews and native nested buy preview/commit eligibility; it leaves authored departure, mission settlement and restitution separate. Original restitution reconciliation can reopen the specific actual demand without extra payout or stock.
